1263-3025-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-3025-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

151-4324-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-4324-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-4324-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Workshop Elders.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2595-4694-5231-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4826-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7933.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

341-1090-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1809-1987-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1809-1987-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-647-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-647-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-4742-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4742-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

372-813-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1879-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1879-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Rising of the Day so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

1978-3043-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
1978-3043-3263.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat

678-5553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.

104-3197-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

186-1497-3755-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2281-3305-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding one mana of any color.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-3573-5089.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3573-5089.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-2821-3573-5089.description:
Animate Candelabra using Karn
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

225-880-1659.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
225-880-1659.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1003-1350-2757-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Plains.
1003-1350-2757-5705.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Phyrexian Walker, untapping the Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Plains.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

859-2569-4289-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Rukarumel.
859-2569-4289-4452.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1528-1578-3525.notablePrerequisites: All permanents attached to the same creature without summoning sickness.
1528-1578-3525.description:
Cast Manamorphose by paying {1}{R/G}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting and Freed from the Real attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Manamorphose.
Resolve the copy of Manamorphose, adding {U}{R} and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.

174-1636-4050-5168.notablePrerequisites:
You control a white and black permanent.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
174-1636-4050-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

613-2655.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
613-2655.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Professor Onyx triggers, losing each opponent two life and gaining you 2 life.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Professor Onyx triggers, losing each opponent two life and gaining you 2 life.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Professor Onyx triggers for each copy, losing each opponent two life and gaining you 2 life each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Professor Onyx triggers, losing each opponent two life and gaining you 2 life.
Repeat from step 7.

141-855-1638-2060.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Naru Meha and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

662-1902-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
662-1902-1978.description:
Cause Wirewood Channeler to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat from step 2.

1738-2034-2302-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Serra Avatar, adding {C}{C}.
Serra Avatar and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Serra Avatar trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Serra Avatar, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
